decisions.reason: The operator line builds directly on the firm's core door and drive knowledge and has had years of market feedback that the firm can interpret and use to refine it.
The solid wood door lies outside the steel core and remains a niche, but it completes the one-source garage range and dealer feedback lets the firm judge it, so keeping it is still justified.
The remote-control operator rests on knowledge the firm already holds and complements its garage doors, though it may eventually be merged into the Product A line.
The insulated glazed door draws on the firm's thermal expertise and meets rising energy-efficiency demand, which the firm can develop further through its own R&D.
The glazed sectional door sits squarely within existing manufacturing and materials knowledge and had priority status, unlike the withdrawn variant D.
